selection_order: Evaluate both preregistered candidates on every suite. Prefer the promotion-relative candidate if all gates pass; otherwise consider the exact-only no-promotion candidate under the same gates; otherwise preserve C7-frozen. No destructive ablation is eligible.
candidate_policy: Preserve frozen supported decisions; use C7 exact learned categories and separately trained promotion transitions only for unresolved candidates. Never drop destination occupancy from the candidate projection.
promotion_scope: Partial learned local transition; existing native exposure chains remain separate.
promotion_gate: All established and new acceptance suites: zero observed false-legal, false-illegal, self-check and incomplete results; no loss of prior supported decisions or recall/exact sets; all negative controls, source boundaries, native parity, cache parity, clean bootstrap and tests pass. Otherwise retain C7-frozen.
holdout_policy: Structural-combination and adversarial families are distinct from training families. No exact/symmetry/translation lineage or game overlap. Shared reusable local subrelations are measured explicitly.
calibration: Offline validation-fit empirical diagnostics only; never alter native truth values or classification.
git_policy: Local commits only; no push or external publication.
